agent_authored_scene: At a tiny neighborhood lantern festival after a brief shower, a fictional adult with reference-guided short dark hair celebrates beside a steaming drink cart. Both sleeve-covered hands droop as little cat paws at chest height; one eye winks while the open lower lid holds a visible pool of happy tears, and the mouth smiles. Wet stone steps, a cloth canopy and warm lantern bokeh establish cool evening depth.

criteria.obligation: Several physically plausible lantern or distant stall point lights form visibly defocused circles behind the sharply rendered face and hands. A global blur or painted circles do not pass.
criteria.native_target: Background point lights and foreground/background focus relationship

criteria.obligation: Two human hands belong to the same adult, raised near the chest with elbows bent, each wrist drooping and fingertips loosely curled inward in a small paw-like gesture. The visible hand portions and sleeve/forearm continuity must support two plausible hands. A peace sign, clenched boxing fists, flat palms, animal paws, or an obscured unjudgeable hand do not pass.
criteria.native_target: Both hands, curls, arm ownership and connected articulation

criteria.obligation: Exactly one eye is visibly closed while the other is visibly open, within the same facial expression. Two closed eyes, two open eyes or an unobservable eyelid do not pass.

The open eye has a discrete visible accumulation of liquid at the lower eyelid while a soft smile is simultaneously visible. Ordinary eye catchlight, wet-looking skin or sad tears without a smile do not pass.

The intentionally long knit cuffs extend beyond the wrists over the bases of the fingers on both hands, leaving enough curled fingertips visible to judge the paw gesture. Ordinary wrist-length sleeves do not pass.
criteria.native_target: Both sleeve ends and hand/cuff relation

criteria.obligation: A fictional clearly adult subject is situated at one small neighborhood lantern festival in a single photographic frame, with at least four distinct combined scene elements visible: paper lanterns, rough knit cuffs, wet stone steps, steam at a small drink cart, hanging cloth canopy, and cool/warm mixed evening light. At least four must be individually observable, and the frame must have coherent depth.

Reference use preserves the visible short dark bob, airy fringe, softly tapered jaw, dark eyes, and recognizable broad facial proportions without inventing real identity, actual age, personality or health. Rendered subject is agent-authored adult, not a claim about reference identity.
criteria.native_target: Face and hair compared with reference

criteria.obligation: The face, eyelids, mouth, both hands and sleeve contacts are available for inspection at saved native resolution. Plausible anatomy and articulation remain judgeable; no requested gesture may be dropped through occlusion or cropping.

whole_score_rule: PASS only if all frozen testcase obligations and all actual pack hard render gates PASS; FAIL or UNOBSERVABLE makes overall FAIL. Tool moderation or execution blocking is BLOCKED_UNSCORED.
reference_scope: Visible face and short dark hair only; no source outfit, source expression or source crop inheritance; no real identity/age/personality/health inference.
